_comment: What a reply carries besides its own words: the quoted history and the signature, in the six languages LIA speaks. Grouped by FAMILY: the expected kept text is language-independent, only the marker changes, so each expectation is written ONCE and checked against six bodies. Two consumers: the deterministic test (48 cases, CI, no network) and the on-demand measurement script (`task emails:corpus:measure`), which also scores a third-party trimmer when one is installed, so the choice between the two is measured, never assumed (ADR-287).
